business_summary: Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in educational, and healthcare and nursing business in Japan and internationally. The company operates classrooms for a range of children including preschoolers to junior high school students. It is also involved in publishing content business, such as issuing and selling publications through sales companies and bookstores; planning, production, purchasing, and sales of publications for kindergartens and nursery schools, childcare supplies, play equipment, apparel for teachers, etc.; and planning, development, and operation of nursing care service centers, mainly housing for the elderly with services. The company was formerly known as Gakken Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2009. Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Zenrin Co., Ltd. engages in the collection and management of a range of geospatial information worldwide. It manufactures and sells maps, including residential maps, map databases, and other content; and map database maintenance services, as well as provides map services, map software, in-car navigation software, and related IT services. The company also manufactures and sells printed materials; development and sales of web systems; research and development of software; development of map database; development and sales of package system; provides marketing and business solutions; and location-based services. In addition, it is involved in the development of software and services related to Zenrin integrated geospatial system, and corporate venture capital business. Further, the company offers easy sales promotion map, and building point data services; residential map for web, planned maps / custom-made maps, and drone; and 3D map data, logistics services, and ScanX services, as well as engages in mobility solutions business. Zenrin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

business_summary: Shobunsha Holdings, Inc. engages in the planning, producing, and publishing maps, magazines, and guidebooks in Japan. It plans, produces, and sells digital data, as well as provides electronic services. The company also produces maps and guidebooks in foreign languages for tourists; offers tools available on the Internet, smartphones, and in mobile communication; and serves as an advertising media for various range clients in the hotel, transportation, retail, and other industries. In addition, it offers domestic travel guide, including Mapple, Mapple Theme Edition, Kotorippu, Kotorippu Magazine, Color Plus, and Other domestic guides; overseas travel guide, such as Mapple Overseas Edition, Kotorippu Overseas Edition, Mapple WORLD, Travel phrasebook, and Other overseas guides; map products comprising Road map, City walking map, Large format, single-sheet map, World map / Japan map, Mountain and Plateau Map, Touring Mapple, and Other Maps; books and knowledge products, such as Historians, Instruction Manual series, Easily Understandable Series, and Other books; children's books, including Mapple Kids, Mapple Kids: Learn by Sticking, Picture book, globe, and Other children's books; and calender and other products. Further, the company provides digital maps and travel guides for national agencies, local governments, and private enterprises for issues concerning crime and disaster prevention, disaster measures, tourism business, regional marketing, customer management, and logistics. 地図・ガイドブックのトップブランドとして、生活・ビジネスはもちろん、休日の旅とおでかけシーンまで、永年にわたり多くのお客さまにご愛顧いただいております。ビジネスマン、ドライバー、働く女性、ママと子ども、ライダーや登山愛好家など、顧客層とライフスタイルにぴったり合った一冊を、全国の書店・コンビニエンスストアなどを通じてお届けしています。 オリジナルツール 地図・ガイドブック制作のノウハウや技術力を活かし、各企業、自治体よりパンフレット、ノベルティグッズなどのオリジナルツールの企画制作を請け負っています。外国人観光客向けに外国語の地図・ガイドブック制作や、WEB、携帯、スマートフォンと連動した集客サービスなど、多様化するニーズへの対応力と、クオリティの高い製品力でお客さまのご要望にお応えしています。 広告サービス 昭文社グループの出版物は、エリアやターゲットにより細かくセグメンテーションされており、ホテル、旅館、交通、ショップなど、多くのクライアントから、広告媒体として高い支持を得ています。タイアップ広告、ブックインブック広告、クロスメディア広告など、多種多様な広告手法で広告サービスを展開しています。 電子事業 WEBサービス 昭文社グループの持つ地図や豊富なガイドコンテンツを活用した各種WEBサイトを運営。日本国内、国外に向けて旅とおでかけの情報を発信しています。 大人気ガイドブック『ことりっぷ』など出版物と連動したWEBサイトでは、誌面に載せきれない最新情報や、季節のおでかけ情報などを掲載し、読者の旅行計画がより便利で快適になるようサポートしています。 モバイル事業 携帯・スマートフォンなどモバイル事業を展開。地図・ガイドコンテンツを活用した各種アプリ開発、運営を行っています。また、『まっぷるリンク』をはじめ昭文社グループのガイドブックや地図とアプリを連動させ、旅の計画から現地での持ち歩き、ナビゲーションまで、旅とおでかけを便利にサポートしています。 デジタルコンテンツ提供およびコンテンツを活用したコンサルティング 官公庁や自治体、多くの民間企業向けに、地図・ガイドコンテンツ、地図配信サービスなどを導入。防犯防災、災害対策、観光事業、エリアマーケティング、顧客管理、物流管理といった幅広いシーンで、さまざまな課題を解決するためのコンサルティングセールスを展開しています。最近では、各種ポータルサイト、店舗案内サービスなど、地図とガイド情報を活用した集客支援サービスで実績を高めています。 GIS・マッピング事業 各企業、自治体の地理情報システムの構築、マッピング業務の受託を行っています。マッピングソフトの開発から入力まで、トータルでサービスを行うGISベンダーとして、ローコストかつ高品質なGIS・マッピング事業を実現しています。 ナビゲーション事業 long_name: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated
business_summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and retail of electric power in Japan and internationally. It generates power through nuclear, fuel, and thermal, as well as solar, geothermal, hydro, and offshore wind power plants; and engages in the procurement, transportation, and trading of fuel. The company is also involved in the gas supply business. In addition, it provides consulting services, as well as engages in real estate rental business; Uranium mining and smelting; system development and maintenance; design and maintenance of power distribution equipment, sales and management of utility pole advertisements; back-office operations; and sales, construction, repair, leasing, electrical work and management of machinery and equipment. Further, the company is involved in investment projects; hydroelectric power generation business; storage and management; hotel and golf course management; design project; charging service, and charging network service business; and planning, proposals, design and construction related to energy conservation in new and existing buildings, and sales and installation of building equipment, etc. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Electric Power Company, Incorporated and changed its name to Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated in April 2016. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated is a subsidiary of Nuclear Damage Compensation And Decommissioning Facilitation Corporation.

Chubu Electric Power Company, Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and retail of electricity in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: JERA, Power Grid, and Miraiz. It generates electricity through geothermal, hydro, wind, biomass, and solar sources. The company is also involved in the fuel upstream, power generation procurement, and wholesale of electricity and gas businesses; and provides power network services. In addition, it engages in construction and manufacture related to the energy business. Further, the company is involved in the gas supply and real estate activities. Additionally, the company engages in renewable energy, nuclear power, and community support infrastructure related business, as well as overseas business. Chubu Electric Power Company, Incorporated was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

long_name: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated
business_summary: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in electricity, heat supply, telecommunication, and gas supply in Japan. It operates through four segments: Energy Business; Power Transmission and Distribution Business; Information and Communication Business; and Lifestyle and Business Solution Business. The company generates power from thermal, hydropower, wind, biomass, and nuclear power generation plants. It also involved in the power transmission and distribution business; the provision of information and communication services for homes and businesses under the eo Hikari brand; mobile business under the mineo business; corporate solution business; and real estate leasing, sales, and management activities; and leisure, leasing, call center management, medical and health care, and home security businesses. In addition, the company engages in the design, construction, operation, maintenance, and management of power generation, power distribution, electrical, and information communication facilities, and information and communication equipment; manufacture and sale of electrical wiring hardware, insulators, bushings, steel pipe columns, concrete poles, and other electrical distribution equipment and materials; housing equipment sales; construction contracting; renovation work; and passenger/freight transportation. Further, it involved in the survey and research on safety technology for nuclear power generation; survey, design, and construction supervision related to civil engineering, etc.; and provision of survey, analysis, consulting, and construction services related to the environment, civil engineering, and architecture, as well as public relations and engineering services. The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc. engages in generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Services, Commercial Operations, and Information and Communications. It generates power through hydroelectric, thermal, nuclear, renewable, and other energy sources. The company provides thermal power, nuclear power, hydroelectric power, transportation facilities, telecommunications, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing, and other materials and equipment, as well as consulting services. In addition, it owns and operates general hydropower and pumped storage power stations, as well as constructs and operates technology of photovoltaic power plant. Further, the company is involved in natural gas-fired power generation; coal-fired power generation; real estate and building management; insurance agency business; contract services; power transmission and distribution business; manufacturing and sales of concrete products; accounting services; civil engineering and foundation works; coal ash recycling; employee welfare service. The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc. was incorporated in 1951 and is based in Hiroshima, Japan.

It is also involved in the sale of LNG; construction of thermal and nuclear power plant equipment; architecture, civil engineering, and paving works; design and construction business; maintenance of hydroelectric power generation substation; distribution facilities; electricity, air conditioning, water supply and drainage, communication equipment construction, and plumbing business; and manufacturing and sale of concrete poles and piles. The company also engages in providing data transmission line and office support work services; development and sale of software, logistics management system, and stem contract; real estate rental and management, temporary staffing, and leasing business; energy solutions, home sales, and gas retail business; execution of environmental greening projects; civil engineering and construction works; administrative services related to administrative indirect operations. In addition, it is involved in investment management business; manufacturing, repair and testing of electricity meters; manufacturing and sales of transformers and switchboards; cable television broadcasting service and internet service; construction and operation of black pellet manufacturing plants. The company was incorporation in 1951 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.

business_summary: Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated operates as an energy service in Japan and internationally. It generates and supplies electricity through hydroelectric, thermal, wind, solar, nuclear power stations. Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

Shikoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in generating, transmitting, distributing, and selling electricity in Japan and internationally. The company generates electricity through nuclear, thermal, hydro, solar, and other sources. It is also involved in the telecommunication and information system services; cable TV broadcasting; studying, designing, engineering, and maintenance of electricity-related facilities; planning and designing of civil engineering and construction; engineering work for power supply facilities; and sales and engineering of electric water heaters and air-conditioning systems. In addition, the company engages in the construction and operation of LNG fuel bases; storage and delivery of LNG; investment and financing for overseas projects; procurement, sale, and trading of coal; and the manufacture and sale of automatic gauging control and information transmission systems. Further, it is involved in real estate businesses; planning and production of advertisements; office-related services; and research and development of technologies related to the electric utility business and other businesses. As of March 31, 2026, it operated electric power generating facilities with a total capacity of 5,336 MW, including 1,158 MW of hydro, 3,285 MW of thermal, 890 MW of nuclear, and 3 MW of solar power generating facilities. The company serves 7,406 million kWh to residential; and 15,488 million kWh to industrial and commercial customers. Shikoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

business_summary: Hokkaido Electric Power Company, Incorporated generates, transmits, and distributes electricity in Japan. The company undertakes electrical and telecommunication, civil engineering and construction, piping, air-conditioning, water supply and drainage facility, and disaster prevention equipment works, as well as engages in the manufacture, maintenance, sale, and electric meters. It also engages in energy conservation business; sale of fuel, equipment and materials; civil engineering and construction materials; rental condominiums and apartments, and parking lot business; and travel, insurance agency, utility pole advertising, cleaning/security service business, and public bathhouse business. In addition, the company provides construction consultant services for civil engineering, construction, electricity, environment, and energy; electricity meter inspection and billing, energy conservation, and energy-saving services; telecommunication services; information processing system consulting, development, operation, management, training, sale of information processing equipment and software, internet data center business, and other information processing-related services; and document management improvement, and confidential document destruction and recycling services. Further, it engages in the commissioning, repairing, maintaining, and consulting for power generation facilities; and receipt, storage, and delivery of overseas coal, maritime transport agent, and customs clearance business. Additionally, the company designs, prints, book binds, and produces broadcasts and videos; sells novelties, gift products, and everyday goods, food, etc.; leases LNG receiving facilities; inspection agency business; and operates and maintains thermal, hydroelectric, photovoltaic, and wind power generation plants. Hokkaido Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

business_summary: EF-ON Inc. operates as an energy service company in Japan. The company operates through Energy Conservation Support Service Business and Green Energy Business segments. The company is also involved in the electricity retail and forestry business. It offers, products such as boiler and hot water supply equipment, compressors, refrigerators, air conditioning equipment, lighting equipment, and other equipment. business_summary: eREX Co.,Ltd. engages in the electric power business in Japan. The company operates biomass power plants; and engages in a hydrogen power generation demonstration project. It is also involved in the development and production of biomass fuels from wood pellets; carbon credit business; electricity trading; and electricity retailing to corporate and individual consumers. eREX Co.,Ltd. incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

RENOVA, Inc. engages in the development and operation of renewable energy power plant in Japan. It operates through Renewable Energy Power Generation Business and Development and Operation Business segments. The Renewable Energy Power Generation Business segment generates and sells electricity from renewable energy power plants. The Development and Operation Business develops and assists in the operation of renewable energy power plants. It generates electricity through solar, biomass, onshore wind, geothermal, and hydro power plants, as well as engages in energy storage business. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. provides natural gas, electricity, and other energy products and services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Domestic Energy, Overseas Energy, and Life & Business Solutions. The Domestic Energy Business segment manufactures, supplies, and sells city gas; sells gas appliances; installs gas pipelines; sells and transports LNG; sells LPG and industrial gas; and generates and sells electricity, as well as engineering and construction for gas and environmental facilities. The Overseas Energy Business segment engages in development and investment related to natural gas; and supply of energy. The Life & Business Solutions Business segment is involved in real estate development and rental; information processing services; and the sale of fine materials and carbon material products. In addition, it is involved in home renovation; the sales of heat supply; engineering; operation, management, and maintenance of buildings and facilities; software development; manufacturing and selling fine materials, carbon material products, activated carbon, and wood protective coating. Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1897 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Toho Gas Co., Ltd. engages in the gas, LPG and other energy, electric power, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the extraction and trade of natural gas and other energy resources; sale of coke, tar products, petroleum products, paving materials, automobiles, daily necessities, food, and beverages; design, supervision, and construction of civil engineering, architectural, electrical, plumbing, and machinery installation works; and sale, leasing, and management of real estate. It also manufactures, transports, and sells high-pressure gases, including liquefied natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas, and liquefied carbon dioxide; gas appliances, air conditioning equipment, kitchen equipment, water supply and drainage equipment, and household electrical appliances; and methanol and plasticizers. In addition, the company engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of air pollution prevention equipment, water pollution prevention equipment, and waste treatment equipment for environmental conservation; soil regeneration treatment; production, sale, and rental of computer-related hardware and software; and sale and rental of crime prevention and disaster prevention equipment. Further, it provides information processing and provision services, communication services, and security services, as well as surveys, research, and consulting services. Additionally, the company is involved in the management of cooking classes, cultural classes, sports facilities, hot spring facilities, training facilities, rental conference rooms, and accommodation facilities; restaurant business and travel agency business; general leasing, finance, advertising, labor dispatch and truck transportation; and non-life insurance agency and life insurance solicitation businesses. Toho Gas Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

business_summary: Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells natural gas in Japan. It operates through four segments: Gas, LPG, Electricity and Other Energy, and Real Estate. The Gas segment includes the production, supply, and sale of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping construction, LNG sales, and renovation services. The LPG segment covers the sale of LPG, LPG equipment, and related construction work. The Electricity and Other Energy segment comprises electricity sales, heat supply, and solar power generation, as well as international energy business such as overseas LNG shipments. The Real Estate segment involves the sale, leasing, and management of real estate, including residential construction and land development. The company also provides information processing services, investment activities, restaurant operations, and manufactures and sells carbon materials, paints, and chemical products. The company was formerly known as Saibu Gas Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

METAWATER Co., Ltd. designs and constructs facilities for water treatment plants, sewage treatment plants, and waste treatment facilities in Japan and internationally. It operates in four segments: Environmental Engineering Business, System Solutions Business, Operation Business, and International segments. The company engages in the design, construction, maintenance, and inspection of mechanical equipment for domestic water and sewage treatment plants and resource recycling facilities; and design, manufacture, maintenance, and management of electrical equipment for domestic water and sewage treatment plants, as well as facilities and equipment for international water and sewage treatment plants, and private sector business. It also operates domestic water and sewage treatment plants and resource recycling facilities; cloud-based platform to support the operation, maintenance, and management of facilities. In addition, the company offers implementation, maintenance, repair, and refurbishing of machines and electrical equipment. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. engages in the mergers and acquisitions (M&A) intermediary activities in Japan. It operates M&A sites and media. The company serves various industries comprising construction, human resources, IT/communication/system development, transportation, real estate, treatment/welfare/nursing, finance/insurance, travel, food and beverages, education, retail, service, manufacturing, leisure facilities, and environment/bio. The company was formerly known as M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. in January 2026. Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: MicroAd, Inc. operates an advertising platform that connects advertisers and the media in Japan. It offers data product services and consulting services. It provides proprietary products with an increasing return on investment model. Additionally, it offers Universe Ads, an advertising platform that analyzes data and distributes advertisements for marketing needs of various industries; and MicroAd COMPASS, a supply-side platform that enhances media ad distribution and maximizes advertising revenue through comprehensive management. The company also provides MONOLITHS, a system that manages the digital OOH network provided by MADS; Outside TV, a cloud-based content management service that provides elements necessary for digital signage operation in one place; LinX, a brand lift measurement solution that visualizes brand recognition rate and product favorability; Enhance Publisher Trading Desk, an advertising distribution menu that allows users to segment target users based on data held by the media and perform targeted distribution; Enhance media monetization consulting services to maximize media value and support comprehensive monetization; and OCTAVE, a tablet-based signage service specialized for beauty salons. MicroAd, Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. MicroAd, Inc. is a subsidiary of CyberAgent Inc.

business_summary: INTLOOP Inc. provides system development, network construction, infrastructure implementation, and IT human resources services in Japan and internationally. The company also offers PMO, web services, professional recruitment support and human resource utilization service, technology solutions. Additionally, it is involved in apparel sales businesses. INTLOOP Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Japaniace Co.,Ltd. engages in the advanced engineering business in Japan. The company offers on-site development support and contract development; software design, development, testing, operation, and maintenance services for the IT, communications, and manufacturing industries; network and server design and construction, operation, and maintenance services for telecommunications carriers, finance, distribution, and government agencies; and mechanical and electrical design of products and equipment for the automotive, office automation, digital equipment, and robotics sectors. It also engages in advanced technology services, including Al, IoT, and cloud computing; research, development, and analytical support services for chemical, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, food, and material manufacturers, as well as the academia, public institutions, and contract testing companies; dispatch of engineers in specialized fields; job placement services for the real estate, facilities, and construction industries; and educational services. In addition, the company is involved in the development and software evaluation of web systems and applications, business and financial systems, and public institution systems; virtual infrastructure construction and operation; system operation and maintenance; security response; system implementation and migration support; function addition and customization; integration with other systems; design and construction of AWS, Azure, and GCP environments; cloud migration support; chemical testing, analysis, and measurement; bio cell and genetic experiments; research and analysis using natural language processing; and inspection and analysis using image processing. Japaniace Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

business_summary: Atlas Technologies Corporation provides fintech consulting and project execution support services in Japan. The company offers consulting and project implementation support services in the insurance field; and services in the IT risk and PMO support fields. It is also involved in planning, consulting, project management, development, and operation of fintech businesses. The company serves banking and capital markets, payment, and insurance industries. Atlas Technologies Corporation was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

The company also provides human resource development consulting and training; and e-learning tools services for education and HR fields. business_summary: Toho Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the film business in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Film Business, IP and Anime Business, Theatrical Business, Real Estate Business, and Other segments. The company is involved in the planning and production of films; utilization of rights, including video streaming; management of cinema complexes; and other video production, art production, and advertising activities. It also engages in the development, production, and rights management of TOHO animation titles, as well as licensing operations for Godzilla; production and exhibition of theatrical plays; and management of entertainment production. In addition, the company is involved in the leasing of office buildings and commercial facilities; road maintenance, repair, and cleaning; and building maintenance, including cleaning, facility management, and security for buildings. Further, it engages in distribution to movie theatres; licensing of merchandising rights; sales and merchandising activities; and operation of sports facilities. Toho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1932 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

H.I.S. Co., Ltd. is involved in the arrangement, planning, and sales of overseas and domestic travel, as well as related businesses in Japan, the United States, the rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Travel Business, Hotel Business, and Kyushu Sanko Group. It also operates hotels, as well as engages in automobile transportation and real estate rental. In addition, the company owns and operates a theme park; provides non-life insurance services, focusing on overseas travel insurance; and develops and operates room reservation systems and related businesses. Further, it engages in facility management; machinery installation and maintenance; and infrastructure projects, such as construction and construction of new buildings. The company was formerly known as International Tours Co., Ltd. and changed its name to H.I.S. Co., Ltd. in 1990. H.I.S. Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Toei Company, Ltd., a content company, engages in the production and distribution of movies, television (TV) shows, and other video products in Japan. The company produces and distributes theatrical films, TV programs, and educational videos; engages in the video licensing business; produces and sells CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray discs, and games; licenses character merchandising rights and copyrights of films and programs; manages theaters and cinema complexes; and runs character shows related to films and videos. It also produces, plans, and holds cultural events; operates TOEI Kyoto studio park and Kyoto film studio; and engages in the construction work and contract interior decoration activities, as well as online sales of products. In addition, the company engages in the rental of commercial buildings, office buildings, and condominiums; owns commercial complexes; and operates and manages hotels. Toei Company, Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

LuckLand Co., Ltd. engages in the research, planning and development, design, construction, supervision, and maintenance services of commercial facilities, retail and food service establishments, logistics facilities, food factories, and hotels. The company is involved in the shop facility construction business comprising site survey, building equipment survey, planning, design, and construction; commercial facility construction business, including building equipment, interior decoration supervision, large store site law adjustment, equipment design, and construction; food factory/logistics warehouse construction business; environmental sector business; and construction, building equipment, and refrigeration equipment businesses. LuckLand Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automotive leasing, chemical, parking, machine tool, synthetic resin, and agriculture businesses in Japan. The company is involved in automobile leasing, fuel sale, and automotive maintenance and outsourcing services; manufacturing of professional-use, techno, fine, and consumer chemical products; and operation of parking lots and plots for supermarkets and hospitals, parking garages affiliated with tenant buildings, and idle lands. It also engages in the development and sale of automotive, industrial machine, air conditioning, and do-it-yourself tools, as well as provision of third-party logistics services; design, manufacturing, and sale of synthetic resins and raw materials, amusement game peripherals, automotive decorative parts, and machinery and tools for processing molds; cultivation and sale of crops, as well as development, manufacturing, and sale of fertilizers; and manufacturing and sale of curved, tempered, laminated, insulating, and decorative glasses, as well as processed glass products. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Shoji Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd. in September 2008. Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. provides professional consulting services in Japan, Asia, the United Kingdom, Europe, and internationally. The company offers professional consulting services related to civil engineering and construction works, such as planning, research, design, and supervision services; disaster countermeasures for floods, droughts, tsunamis, and storm surges; watershed hydrology; seismic countermeasures for river management and coastal protection facilities; port and marine infrastructure; and mechanical and electrical equipment. It is also involved in the planning and design of new dams; provision of solutions for existing dams; sediment disaster countermeasures, including disaster surveys and forecasts; planning, design, and maintenance of erosion control facilities, such as check dams and stream protection works; non-mechanical measures; design of pipes, drains, and related facilities; evaluation of the seismic performance of related structures; design of aseismic reinforcement works; detection of structural degradation; and formulation of asset management plans. In addition, the company plans and designs mechanical equipment for weirs, floodgates, locks, sluice pipes and gates, floodwall gates, and drainage pump stations in river systems; dam discharge facilities; and water treatment facilities for water supply and sewerage systems. Further, it provides traffic planning and operation, and logistics business plans; planning and designing of bridges; regional transportation systems, district transportation plans, and support for transportation projects; information and telecommunications technology, disaster mitigation, environment, and geo-environment services; public procurement assistance; and construction and execution management services. The company was formerly known as Kensetsu Gijyutsu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. in February 1964. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Space Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, design, supervision, and construction of commercial facilities in Japan. The company's commercial facilities include shopping centers, department stores, specialty stores, and restaurants. It is also involved in the planning, design, supervision, and construction of museums and other cultural, sports, and entertainment facilities, as well as urban development, regional development, and environmental improvement projects; and planning, design, production, sale, and import and export of exhibition equipment and display fixtures, indoor and outdoor decorative items, and furniture. It also engages in the purchase and sale of secondhand goods and entrusted services; and business incidental to all preceding items. In addition, the company plans, designs, supervises, and executes construction and interior finishing works; and plans, designs, supervises, and constructs projects related to shows and exhibitions. Further, it is involved in the planning, design, and production related to public relations and advertising; research, consultation, and publishing related to various items; provision of information; and real estate dealings, leasing, and brokerage activities. Space Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2004年、当時の（株）公益社が持株会社に移行し、燦ホールディングス（株）に商号変更した際、会社分割により葬儀事業会社として設立、（株）公益社の商号と共に1932年創業の歴史を継承しました。現在、首都圏・近畿圏で年間1万件以上の葬儀を施行しています。 〈事業エリア〉 首都圏、近畿圏 ホームページ 株式会社葬仙 1980年鳥取県米子市に中国地方で最初の葬儀専用会館を開設して創業。2005年グループ入りし、現在、鳥取県及び島根県の山陰両県に14の葬祭会館を運営しています。 〈事業エリア〉 鳥取県（東部・西部）、島根県（東部） ホームページ 株式会社タルイ 1950年明石市に創業し、1992年以降、幹線道路沿いに葬祭会館を積極的に開設。2006年グループ入りし、現在、明石市と東西の隣接エリアに15の葬祭会館を運営しています。 〈事業エリア〉 兵庫県（明石市、神戸市、加古川市、高砂市） ホームページ 株式会社家族葬のファミーユ 2000年7月に東京都港区に株式会社エポック・ジャパンとして創業。「家族葬のファミーユ」ブランドの家族葬ホール等を北海道・関東・中部・九州の10都道県で運営しています。 〈事業エリア〉 北海道、関東、中部、九州 ホームページ 株式会社花駒 1964年7月に生花販売業「駒花店」として創業。2018年にファミーユグループ入りし、「家族葬のファミーユ」ブランドの家族葬ホール等を関西圏で運営しています。 〈事業エリア〉 京都府、大阪府、奈良県 ホームページ 株式会社備前屋 1970年6月に創業。2021年にファミーユグループ入りし、「家族葬のファミーユ」ブランドの家族葬ホール等を岡山県にて運営しています。 〈事業エリア〉 岡山県 ホームページ 株式会社たまのや 1892年に福島県福島市に創業。福島県、茨城県において、「こころ斎苑」「とわノイエ」ブランドの葬祭会館と仏壇仏具販売店「ぶつだんプラザ」を運営しております。ご遺族の意向に寄り添い、感謝の伝わるご葬儀を提供しております。 〈事業エリア〉 東北・関東 ホームページ 株式会社北関東互助センター 1974年に栃木県宇都宮市に創業、2018年にこころネットグループ入り。栃木県において、「とわノイエ」ブランドの葬祭会館を中心に展開し、葬祭事業と互助会事業を運営しております。ご遺族の想いに添った、感動のご葬儀を提供しております。 〈事業エリア〉 関東 ホームページ 株式会社喜月堂セレオ 1915年に山梨県韮崎市に創業、2023年にこころネットグループ入り。「地域社会に最高のサービスを提供する」をスローガンに山梨県において「セレオホール」「家族葬のセレオ」ブランドの葬祭会館と仏壇販売店「お仏壇の喜月堂」を運営しております。 〈事業エリア〉 中部 ホームページ 株式会社グランセレモ東京 （関連会社） 広済堂ホールディングスと燦ホールディングスの合弁会社です。広済堂ホールディングスグループが保有する桐ヶ谷斎場・落合斎場・代々幡斎場・堀ノ内斎場・町屋斎場・四ツ木斎場の6斎場を利用できる公式の葬儀社です。 〈事業エリア〉 東京都 ホームページ こころネット株式会社 「私たちは、人々の「こころ」に満足と安らぎをもたらすサービスを提供する。」を理念とした葬祭・石材・生花・婚礼・互助会等の事業会社の持株会社。2012年に大証JASDAQに上場、2026年にグループ入り。 〈事業エリア〉 東北 ホームページ エクセル・サポート・サービス株式会社 1999年創業の後、グループ事業再編の中で事業内容と商号を変えつつ、一貫して（株）公益社の葬儀をサポートする役割を担ってきました。現在は、葬儀会館の警備業務、清掃・施設管理業務の受託、葬儀における料理の提供を主たる事業としています。 〈事業エリア〉 首都圏、近畿圏 ホームページ ライフフォワード株式会社 2020年4月に設立、ライフエンディングステージを中心にシニアライフをサポートするため、安心・信頼できる良質のサービス・関連商品をポータルサイトでの紹介を通じて提供しています。 〈事業エリア〉 全国 ホームページ みんなが選んだ終活 株式会社クニカネクスト 2012年5月に開設。「治療院オネスト」として、京都・大阪・滋賀・東京・埼玉で在宅・訪問型の医療マッサージ事業を展開しています。2025年にグループ入りしました。 〈事業エリア〉 京都、大阪、滋賀、東京、埼玉 ホームページ カンノ・トレーディング株式会社 1929年に福島県伊達郡掛田町（現伊達市）に創業。東日本を中心に石材店への石材卸売のほか、福島県、長野県、東京都、茨城県において「石のカンノ」ブランドで墓石販売、霊園紹介、屋内納骨堂販売代行等を行っております。 〈事業エリア〉 東北、関東 ホームページ 石のカンノ（小売） 株式会社フルール 2001年に福島県福島市に創業。こころネットグループ内外の葬祭会社への生花商品の販売のほか、福島県、栃木県、山形県に営業所を設置し、東北、北関東の生花店等への生花卸売を行っております。 〈事業エリア〉 東北、関東 ホームページ 株式会社ハートライン 1972年に福島県福島市に創業。月掛金を一定期間払込み、将来の葬儀や婚礼の費用に充てる会員制度が互助会です。互助会会員様が葬儀、婚礼の役務サービスを安心してご利用できるようサポートしております。 〈事業エリア〉 東北 ホームページ グループについて ごあいさつ 経営理念 会社概要・アクセス 役員一覧 組織図 沿革 グループ会社 葬儀会館一覧 燦ホールディングスグループがめざすもの 動画コーナー business_summary: PCA Corporation develops and sells computer software in Japan. The company offers accounting solutions, including bill management option, consolidated settlement option, data linkage option, workflow, payment management, cost management, cost management for construction industry, international trading, and consolidated accounting solutions. It also provides HR management solutions comprising time clock, shift management, attendance management workflow, payment statement electronic distribution, social insurance and labor insurance management, payment record, daily payroll, and business form design solutions. In addition, the company offers order entry simultaneous entry option, sales/purchase simultaneous entry option, convenience store receiving agent option, data linkage option, specified slip issuance, POS cash register, sales force automation (SFA), customer management, handy terminal, EDI, and business form design solutions. PCA Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Kin-Ei Corp. engages in the management and operation of rental buildings for movie theaters in Japan. business_summary: Saison Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the system development and operation, and software package businesses in Japan. It operates through HULFT Business, Data Platform Business, and System Outsourcing Business segments. The company offers HULFT, a data management solution; HULFT Square and DataSpider Servista, which are cloud-based data integration platforms; HULFT 10, enables transfer and share files between systems; HULFT DataCatalog, that catalogs various scattered data; HULFT-HUB, a data integration relay hub; DataMagic, that provides data conversion processing for business systems; HULFT-WebConnect, a file transfer service. Further, it provides various services, including AI-powered services, data integration platform construction, building a data utilization platform, core system/ERP integration platform, CRM integration platform, HR system integration platform, file integration platform, and support for in-house data integration. The company was formerly known as Saison Information Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Saison Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2024. Saison Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Tanabe Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the management consulting activities in Japan. The company provides strategy consultants for business management, business model transformation, food, manufacturing, construction, global business, government, and public services; digital consultant includes DX vision, digital marketing, management DX, and strategy and operations; HR consultant for strategic HR, human capital management, recruitment and career design, corporate university, top management programs, HR tech, and talent assessment; and marketing and sales consultant includes new business ventures run by female teams, customer creation for existing businesses, on-site sales support, DE&I support, sales design, and customer success. It also provides corporate well-being consultants for clinical psychologists, mental health and welfare workers, public health nurses, industrial counselors, CEAP, and career consultant; corporate finance consultant includes holdings and group management, business succession, ipo support, alliances, and management systems; merger and acquisition consultant for growth strategy, business succession, financial advisory, and cross-border; brand and PR consultant includes branding, public relations, strategic PR and overseas PR, SNS management, and content marketing management support; and CRM consultant for client relations, MA tools, database marketing, and telemarketing. The company was formerly known as Tanabe Consulting Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Kyowa Engineering Consultants Co., Ltd. provides construction consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers structure construction and maintenance services, such as survey, planning, and design of bridges, underground structures, water and sewage facilities, tunnels, utility tunnels, etc.; inspection and repair technologies; and construction management services. It also provides regional development and creation services, including urban development, survey, planning, and design of roads, parks, green spaces, and land development; surveys, predictions, and countermeasures for the social and natural environment; and offers landscape studies. In addition, the company provides disaster prevention and mitigation services comprising investigation, planning, and design of rivers, waterways, sluice gates, and related facilities; erosion control-related investigation and planning services; and geotechnical and hydrological investigations and analyses. Further, it offers energy resource surveys for solar, hydro, wind, and biomass; implementation planning and design services; regional utilization plans; and building support services. Additionally, the company provides architecture services, such as seismic diagnosis of buildings, seismic design, and improvement of the asset value of building facilities. It offers investigation and design of drinking water development projects; construction supervision and support for non-revenue water countermeasures; and support for renewable energy development, as well as promotes small-scale hydropower generation. The company also engages in real estate rental and management activities; information processing, personnel dispatch; and software development activities; and sale of information processing equipment. It serves government agencies. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

business_summary: Tokyotokeiba Co.,Ltd. engages in rental of horse racing facilities in Japan. The company is involved in rental of auto racetracks, as well as provision of Oi Racecourse, a racecourse that holds night races. It also engages in management of amusement park; and rental of warehouse, commercial, and logistics facilities, as well as betting systems. In addition, the company offers construction management services and maintenance services for air conditioning equipment. Further, it manages and operates shopping malls and office buildings. Additionally, the company operates restaurants. Tokyotokeiba Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: HORAI Co., Ltd. engages in the insurance, real estate, dairy, and golf businesses in Japan. The company offers insurance agency services, including automobile, fire, and other non-life insurance, as well as life, and term and cancer insurance. It also engages in the rental, buying, selling, and brokerage of office buildings and residential properties, as well as leasing land to solar power generation companies. In addition, the company operates Senbonmatsu ranch; manufactures and sells milk and dairy products; and engages in breeding, milking, and feed production of dairy cattle. Further, it is involved in the management of restaurants, amusement facilities, and other industrial tourism facilities; and operation of Horai Country Club and Nishinasuno Country Club. The company was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in the content and service businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Digital Entertainment Business, Amusement Business, Publishing Business, and Rights and Properties Business segments. The company plans, develops, sells, and manages digital entertainment content primarily in the form of computer games. It is also involved in the operation of amusement facilities; planning, development, manufacture, sale, and rental of arcade game machines and related products. In addition, the company publishes and licenses comic books, magazines, game-related books, periodicals, etc. Further, it plans, produces, develops, and licenses secondary works; and offers content under the SQUARE ENIX PRODUCTS brand. Additionally, the company develops derivative products and services including planning, manufacturing, and selling merchandise; managing music-related projects; organizing events, concerts, and exhibitions; and operating official stores, pop-up shops, collaboration cafés, and driving licensing initiatives. Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: KYCOM Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, consults, plans, designs, develops, and maintains information systems in Japan. The company operates in four segments: Information Processing Business, Real Estate Business, Rental Business, and Wireless Solutions Business. It offers system development, IT consulting and services, infrastructure construction, operation and maintenance support, data entry work, help desk, outsourcing contracted business, development and sale of fingerprint authentication systems, and leasing of office equipment and computer devices. The company also provides wireless communication solutions, including installation, repair, inspection, and maintenance of wireless equipment, as well as disaster prevention. In addition, it is involved in the management of apartment buildings; solar power generation; and car rental business. The company was formerly known as Kyodo Computer Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to KYCOM Holdings Co., Ltd. in June 2011. KYCOM Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

business_summary: KSK Co.,Ltd. engages in the LSI, software, hardware, customer service, and data entry businesses. It operates through System Core Business; IT Solutions Business; and Network Service Business segments. The company engages in semiconductor design, such as LSIs and FPGAs; image sensors; mechanical and electrical design; embedded software development; and IoT solutions, as well as BPO business. It also provides standard information platform for the housing industry, and system development and operation for home builders; cloud-based business support tools for the building maintenance; mobile app development; production management system; pay roll system; and accounting system. business_summary: Ryomo Systems Co.,Ltd. provides software development and system sales, information processing, product-related sales, and other information services in Japan. It offers administrative, family register information comprehensive, financial accounting, counter support, school lunch, smart city, and collection management solutions; water rate adjustment, public enterprise accounting system, image information management system, as well as toll collection, water supply installation management, and other meter data information creation solution; and educational network construction, school affairs and class support, and library management services. The company also provides customer portals for gas and electricity retailing; customer charge management, and gas business management solutions; and solutions for manufacturing industry. In addition, it offers printing and functional safety solutions; MBD consulting, autonomous driving system verification, commissioned development, check tool, and education training solutions, as well as HILS support solutions; medical solutions, such as medical office, drug management guidance work support, and regional medical collaboration, electronic medical record systems, and other solutions; and solutions for sales and customer management, online shopping, POS data analysis, electronic commerce, and labor scheduling programs in the distribution sector. Further, the company provides cloud service, share box, electronic eco filing system, counter measure service, housing service, network service, data center, facility equipment, managed, printing, and data entry service, and website design service. The company was formerly known as Ryomo Computing Center Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ryomo Systems Co.,Ltd. in June 1982. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Kiryu, Japan. Ryomo Systems Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsuba Corporation.

Computer Engineering & Consulting Ltd. operates as an independent system integrator in Japan. It operates through Integration, Connected, and Solution segments. The company offers system development, construction, maintenance, and operation services; ICT implementation support; package software installation support; temporary staffing; information systems planning; and infrastructure design, development, and operation services, as well as services based on the use and analysis of digital data. It also provides CRM/ERP, migration, My Number, mobility, security, smart factory, AI/IoT, connected, digital transformation (DX), data center, and cloud solutions. In addition, the company is involved in the development and sale of systems and packages. It serves the manufacturing, logistics and distribution, financial, and medical industries; government agencies, local authorities, and public organizations; and sales and general affairs departments. Computer Engineering & Consulting Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

business_summary: Creo Co.,Ltd. engages in the development of information processing systems and provision of related services in Japan. It operates through Solution Service Business, Development, System Operation/Service Business, and Support Service Business segments. The company offers SmartStage front series, a lineup of front-end business SaaS solutions; Tramil, a purchasing process management cloud; SmartStage, an IT service management solution; CREO-RPA, an internal control-compliant RPA service; CREO-OCR, a high-precision handwriting recognition using an AI-OCR engine; Smart Stage hyper digital platform; and BIZ PLATFORM, a business process management platform. It also provides ZeeM Cloud, a DX promotion framework; ZeeM HR and Payroll integrates HR management and payroll calculation; ZeeM human resources and payroll for educational institution; ZeeM labor and social insurance outsourcing service; ZeeM lease asset management; ZeeM accounting; and ZeeM fixed asset management. In addition, the company offers QuickBinder, a document management system; cloud business solutions, which include building cloud sites and infrastructure development, as well as planning, designing, and operating services; construction of core business systems; development services for local government; 2Media, a media content creator solution; Success Mark, supports business automation and artificial intelligence; cross media solution; and Veva HR evaluation systems and Yahoo! Safety confirmation services. Further, it provides contract system development; system development, maintenance, and operation; and help desk and technical support. The company was formerly known as Tokai Create CO., LTD. and changed its name to Creo Co.,Ltd. in April 1989. Creo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the construction machinery rental business in Japan and internationally. The company offers various construction machinery for special sites, expressways/railways/airports/harbors, industrial complexes and plants, and repair works, as well as equipment for events and exhibitions, such as tents, stages, monitors, temporary stands, etc.; and support from transporting to assembling/disassembling the equipment. It also leases construction equipment, industrial machinery, machines for factory equipment maintenance, lifting equipment, tools, tower cranes, mobile elevated work platforms, power generators, and survey instruments; provides transportation services, construction work support, consulting, community-based services, compulsory vehicle liability insurance, electrical engineering works, temporary electrical installations, parking lot management, and car rental services; and develops and rents wastewater treatment equipment and hardware. In addition, the company rents and sells shoring equipment, laser measurement devices, equipment for managing working environments in factories, devices supporting reduced energy usage, forklift trucks, and elevated work platforms; specialized vehicles, including battery electric and hybrid vehicles; designs and constructs hybrid trusses; and repairs and inspects crane trucks, specialized vehicles, forklift trucks, and other vehicles. The company was formerly known as Nishio Rent All Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

It operates through three segments: Facilities Management, Merchandise Sales, and Food and Beverage. business_summary: The Royal Hotel, Limited operates hotels in Japan. The company operates hotels under the RIHGA Royal Hotel name in Osaka, Tokyo, Kyoto, Hiroshima, Kokura, Chugoku, Shikoku, Okinawa, and Kyushu Kagawa. It provides accommodation, catering, and rental spaces. The company was formerly known as Shin Osaka Hotel, Ltd. and changed its name to The Royal Hotel, Limited in 1973. The Royal Hotel, Limited was founded in 1932 and is based in Kita, Japan.

business_summary: transcosmos inc. provides business outsourcing services in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Single Service, Domestic Affiliates, and Overseas Affiliates. The company offers business processing outsourcing services, such as selling, SCM, finance, and documentation; accounting, procurement, and human resources; construction support housing and housing equipment design; machine design, built-in development, and back-office for design and production; support desk, system operation and maintenance, IoT, and multi-device lifecycle; and offshore services. It also provides contact center, customer care, sales support, industry-specific call center, contact center technologies, and analytics services. In addition, the company offers digital marketing services that make use of Internet promotions, digital integration, integrated marketing, channel-integrated communication, marketing tool support, and social media services. Further, it provides e-commerce services, including various functions required for e-commerce, such as e-commerce consulting services, website launch services, service network, online merges with offline, marketing and CRM services, fulfillment services, and one-stop services. Additionally, the company offers analytics services, including customer research, big data analytics, direct marketing consulting, customer support consulting, and market research and analytics; and other DEC integrated marketing services. transcosmos inc. was founded in 1966 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Hotel Newgrand Co., Ltd. operates hotels in Japan. It operates through Hotel and Real Estate Leasing segments. The company offers accommodation and dining facilities, including weddings and banquets within the Hotel New Grand; and restaurants within the Takashimaya Yokohama and Sogo Yokohama stores. It also provides rental management services for office buildings and other properties. Hotel Newgrand Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

business_summary: KNT-CT Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides travel related services in Japan. The company is involved in planning and sales of travel products, tours, and overseas group tours; media sales through newspaper advertisements; and the distribution of the information magazine Tabi no Tomo, as well as online sales. It also engages in consignment business; temporary staffing; trading and insurance businesses; outsourcing businesses; catalog advertising production businesses; wholesale of domestic and international group and individual travel and international airline tickets. In addition, it operates website YOKOS. JAPANTOUR. KNT-CT Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. KNT-CT Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.

TOKAI Corp. provides various healthy life services in Japan. It operates through Health and Life Services, Pharmacy Services, and Environmental Services segments. The company engages in hospital-related business that includes rental of hospital bedding and white coats, linen supply, nursing assistance, and in-hospital logistics management. It is also involved in the rental and sale of nursing care products and home renovation services under the nursing care insurance system; operation of MIC Health Forest day service facility for the rehabilitation for the elderly; development and manufacture finishing process machinery and equipment for dry cleaning factories; provision of meal services comprising regular and therapeutic meals; and water delivery business under the Aqua Clara brand. In addition, the company engages in the operation of Tanpopo Pharmacy specialty dispensing pharmacy and Drugmic drugstore chain; rental of environmental beautification products under the Leaskin brand; cleaning and management of hospital and other buildings; and solar business. business_summary: Hakuyosha Company, Ltd. engages in the cleaning, rental, real estate, and other businesses in Japan. It provides a range of products for home clothing care, including detergents and fabric softeners that are used in home washing machines, as well as insect repellents and clothes covers. The company also rents various linen items, including sheets, towels, tablecloths, and napkins for hotel and restaurant operations, as well as uniforms; and engages in the rental and management of real estate properties. In addition, it offers bedding and interior cleaning services; cleaning and storage services for clothes, such as coats and jackets, as well as for household items comprising carpets and futons; pick-up and delivery cleaning, dry cleaning delivery, and house cleaning services; and used clothing purchase services. Further, the company operates Texcare, which offers maintenance and restoration services; and sells sell machines and materials for cleaning business. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

business_summary: SECOM CO., LTD., together with its subsidiaries, provides security services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Security Services, Fire Protection Services, Medical Services, Insurance Services, Geospatial Information Services, BPO and ICT Services, and Others segment. Its Security Services segment offers static guard, armored car, merchandise, and other services, as well as online security systems. The Fire Protection Services segment provides fire alarm systems, fire extinguishing systems, and maintenance services to office buildings, production facilities, tunnels, cultural properties, ships, and residences. Its Medical Services segment offers home medical services, including home nursing services and pharmaceutical dispensing services and home delivery services; operation of residences for seniors; sales of electronic medical report systems, medical equipment, and pharmaceutical products; personal care services, and the leasing of real estate for medical institutions. The Insurance Services Segment provides fire insurance, automobile insurance, and cancer treatment insurance services. Its Geospatial Information Services segment offers geospatial information services to national and local governments; private sector customers; and overseas government agencies. The BPO and ICT Services segment provides business continuity planning (BCP) support, information security services, cloud-based services and authentication services centering on the data centers, as well as BPO-related services including operation of contact center services. Its Other Services segment offers real estate leasing, construction, and installation services. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

business_summary: NSW Inc. operates as an enterprise, services, embedded, and device solutions provider in Japan. It provides business solutions, such as consulting, system design, development, maintenance, and operation solutions for manufacturing, distribution, finance, insurance, and government sectors. The company also offers IT services, including servers and networks designing; secure environment development; and operating and monitoring systems, as well as IoT & AI services. In addition, it is involved in the embedded system development business, which include development of applications, middleware, and drivers for automotive and industrial sectors; and edge device solutions. Further, it develops LSI and FPGA for image processing and communication control fields. The company was formerly known as Nippon Systemware Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NSW Inc. in June 2022. NSW Inc. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. provides security services in Japan. The company operates through Security Business, and Building Management and Real Estate Business segments. The company offers on-site security, including facility security, fire and disaster prevention safety management, and VIP personal protection services; mechanical security, such as online and home security; and transport security consisting of security, escort and transportation services for cash, valuables, etc., as well as sells non-life insurance products linked to mechanical security contracts. It also sells and installs surveillance cameras and image monitoring systems; access control systems; and installation and sales of security, fire prevention, and disaster prevention equipment and facilities. Further, the company provides image analysis VACS system, image browsing system, SecurityPlatform ladder, CSP security robot, drone services, Biz Guard S and Biz Guard Revo office security, access control system centrics, apartment security safe room, NEW HiSCT total apartment security, intercom renewal service, unmanned reception system for apartment buildings, AED, safety confirmation service, CSP life support mail, camera malfunctioning monitoring, transport security, comprehensive building management, insurance, mobile emergency reporting system, cyber-attack countermeasures, pest repellent device, and fire hose reel. It also engages in real estate leasing services. It serves hotel, sports gym, coworking spaces, unmanned stores, logistics facilities, small office, building, nursery schools and kindergartens, clinic, restaurant, station, railway depots and substations, apartment, urban commercial facilities, suburban commercial facilities, stadium, factory, and shrines and temples. Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: INES Corporation provides information network system services to industrial corporations, financial institutions, and public entities in Japan. It also offers operation and maintenance services for information systems and communication networks, including IT outsourcing and iDC services for the operation and maintenance of systems; and information system analysis and design, program development, testing, and conversion services, such as software development for the financial, distribution, and service industries, as well as for the public sector. In addition, the company provides system integration services for software and hardware systems comprising the construction of web-based networks, client/server networks, local area networks, and wide-area networks; and sale of mobile PCs, automatic printing device systems, and other equipment. Further, it offers other system-related services, including data input, help desk, and security services, as well as machine-room, and network operation and management, systems maintenance, and training in PC systems; and hardware procurement, staff training and education, ERP consulting, and outsourcing services. The company was formerly known as Kyoei Computer Center and changed its name to INES Corporation in August 1984. INES Corporation was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: TKC Corporation operates as a specialized electronic data processing center for accounting firms and local governments in Japan. It operates through Accounting Firm Business, Local Government Business, and Printing Business segments. It is involved in the provision of information processing, software, and consulting services, as well as desk services; and sale of office equipment and supplies. It also provides printed continuous business forms; manufactures office supplies; development and sale of software; publishes books and monthly magazines on business management, taxation, and accounting; and provides security, maintenance, and repair services for buildings. In addition, the company manufactures and sells general office forms; and provides data printing services. The company was formerly known as Tochigi Prefecture Computing Center Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TKC Corporation in December 1986. TKC Corporation was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

business_summary: OYO Corporation provides geological survey services in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Disaster Prevention and Infrastructure, Environment and Energy, and International. The Disaster Prevention and Infrastructure engages in surveying and restoration design of areas damaged by natural disasters; forecasting damage, such as earthquakes, tsunamis, fires, etc. related to national and local governments disaster prevention plans; consulting on natural disaster risk surveys, loss forecasting, and countermeasures related to corporate business continuity plans; and building, installing, and updating monitoring systems related to natural disasters, including seismometer networks and volcano monitoring systems. This segment also offers inspection, diagnosis, and maintenance services for social infrastructure; survey, design, and measurement services for the development of resilient infrastructure; develops, sells, constructs, installs, and renews non-destructive testing products used for inspections and diagnoses; and constructs, installs, and renews environmental monitoring systems. The Environment and Energy segment provides consulting on surveys and countermeasures focusing on soil and groundwater contamination, asbestos, waste, etc.; surveys and consulting for global warming countermeasures and biodiversity conservation; geological survey consulting related to the construction, installation, and renewal of environmental monitoring systems; methane hydrate development research; support for the commercialization of renewable energy; Undersea3D resource exploration services; and develops and sells resource exploration equipment and systems. The International segment develops, manufactures, and sells non-destructive testing equipment and seismic observation systems, geophysical exploration equipment; and offers survey, design, and construction management services. OYO Corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated provides consulting services for various industries in Japan. It offers logistics services, including consulting, trading, and transportation; management consulting, marketing and executive training, financial advisory, and digital marketing services; and digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Funai Consulting Incorporated and changed its name to Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: NSD Co., Ltd. provides various IT solutions in Japan. The company plans, designs, and develops systems; constructs IT infrastructure; and offers IT-utilized and IT consulting services. In addition, the company offers all-purpose software and duty-specific software products, and software development services. It serves finance, manufacturing, commerce, construction/real estate, service, transportation, telecommunication, and utilities industries. NSD Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Maruken Lease Co., Ltd. leases, sells, repairs, and fabricates temporary steel construction materials in Japan. The company provides sheet piles, H-beams, steel supports, steel decks, steel plates, etc. for foundation construction work. It installs and extracts piles; and undertakes earth retainment and underground continuous wall work. The company also engages in the construction and obstacle removal work comprising general civil engineering, scaffolding and earthworks, stonework, steel structure construction, paving, dredging, painting, interior finish work, thermal insulation, dismantling and water facility works. The company was formerly known as Marubeni Construction Material Lease Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Maruken Lease Co., Ltd. in October 2025. Maruken Lease Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Ohba Co., Ltd. provides consulting services for city planning projects in Japan. The company offers consulting services for the planning of cities, as well as technical support services to landowners in relation to land use and land use conversion. It is involved in the planning and design of roads, waterways, bridges, and water supply and sewage systems; and provision of technical services for creating social infrastructure. In addition, the company offers consulting services related to environmental research and assessments; and handles surveys and investigations involving geography and terrain. Further, it provides land and infrastructure maintenance and management services; and consulting services related to the disposal of real estate, as well as handles land, and drill boring and soil contamination investigations. Additionally, the company offers proposals involving geographic information and other related systems related to urban planning, civil engineering, environmental investigation, and preparation of spatial information. It provides consulting services related to inheritance tax and real estate utilization, as well as proposes solutions for addressing various social issues. Ohba Co., Ltd. was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

（1）従来のコンサルタント業務領域を超えた「土地区画整理・開発行為の業務代行事業への参画」 （2）まちづくり地権者向けワンストップサービス提供のため、税理士法人との連携による「まちづくりと相続税務・不動産活用コンサルティングの実施」 （3）コンパクトシティ実現、生産緑地問題解決、復興住宅展示場運営、民間主体の集団移転事業実施など「まちづくり技術を活かした社会問題の解決提案」 生産緑地所有者の方、より高値での不動産売却、 不動産・税務との連携による総合的な相続コンサルティングなど 個人のお客様向けサービスのご紹介はこちら 信頼への取り組み 当部門は、お客様の大切な財産情報を取り扱うものとして、常にお客様に信頼されるために、「情報セキュリティは、経営上及び事業上の最重要課題のひとつである。」との認識のもと、従業員に情報資産保護の重要性を認識させ、これに取り組みます。 → business_summary: Konami Group Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the digital entertainment, arcade, gaming and systems, and sports businesses in Japan, Asia/Oceania countries, the United States, and Europe. The Digital Entertainment segment engages in the production, manufacture, and sale of digital content and related products, including mobile games, card games, and computer and video games. Its Amusement segment engages in the business planning, design, production, and sale of arcade games; and offers online game services. The Gaming & Systems segment produces, manufactures, sells, and services gaming machines and casino management systems. Its Sports segment operates sports facilities and sports courses, including swimming, gymnastics, dance, soccer, tennis, and golf, as well as produces and sells sports-related goods. The company was formerly known as Konami Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Konami Group Corporation in July 2022. Konami Group Corporation was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Nikken Kogaku Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells wave-absorbing and foot-stabilizing products in Japan. The company offers wave dissipating, coastal revetment blocks, and other civil engineering products. It also provides coastal protection blocks, and riverbank disaster-prevention and environment protection blocks. In addition, the company offers natural stones and geosynthetics products. It serves land, infrastructure, transport, tourism, as well as government, and construction consultants and companies. Nikken Kogaku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: IDEA Consultants,Inc. provides integrated consultancy services on social infrastructure development and environmental conservation projects in Japan and internationally. The company offers research, planning, designing, managing, evaluating, and consulting services related to construction and environmental conservation and improvement; environment work related services, such as surveys, forecasts, analysis, impact assessments, and environmental conservation measures; and physical and chemical analysis, and testing of water quality, air quality, soil, waste, tap water, food, etc. It also manufactures, sells, and leases environmental research and analysis equipment; provides industrial and domestic waste recycling, building and structure design and management, and civil engineering and construction work services; and engages in surveying and geological surveys, as well as real estate acquisition, sales, leasing, brokerage, maintenance, and management services. In addition, the company purchases and sales machinery, equipment, parts, and tools; provides staffing services; and produces and sells honey, royal jelly, pollen, etc. Further, the company offers environmental consulting services, including environmental assessment/environmental planning, conservation, restoration, and creation of the natural environment, environmental survey, chemical analysis and risk assessment, life science, and sustainability management support; construction consulting services comprising land conservation, transportation/logistics infrastructure, urban and regional development, and disaster response and recovery/reconstruction; and information system, such as disaster prevention/environment/construction system development, system operation support, meteorology, disaster prevention, and life information service, as well as infrastructure management services. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Setagaya, Japan.

business_summary: DMS Inc. engages in direct mail service business in Japan. It offers direct marketing services, including planning and production, direct mail target optimization, mailing, personalized direct mail, and delivery services; web marketing services, such as Website and mobile site development; and logistics services, which includes shipping service for E-commerce and mail order businesses, gift campaign logistics services, and logistics for sales promotion support. The company also provides back-office support services, such as call center, data entry, telephone communication services, and other back-office solutions. In addition, it offers sales promotion solutions comprising POP display, poster, and vertical banner advertisement creation; promotional item creation; flyer delivery services; sample product delivery services; and niche media covering enclosed advertisements, etc. Further, the company is involved in planning, producing, creating, and managing sales promotion, sports and cultural, and campus events, as well as leasing services. It also designs planning, performance, production and operations for sporting events, local government projects, exhibitions, fireworks shows, ceremonies and contests, and school events. DMS Inc. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
